When does New Year 2027 start in Spain?

Spain spans 2 different UTC offsets on New Year's Eve, so 2027 arrives in waves. The first region to celebrate is Madrid (UTC+01:00) at 23:00 UTC on Thursday, December 31, 2026, and the last is Canary Islands (UTC+00:00), 1 hour later.

The countdown above follows Madrid, where midnight falls at 23:00 UTC.

New Year's Day 2027 falls on a Friday.

Spain in the global New Year countdown

The first places on Earth to enter 2027 are the Line Islands of Kiribati (UTC+14:00). Madrid follows 13 hours later, and the last inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC-11:00), celebrate 12 hours after Madrid.

When the clock strikes midnight in Madrid, 100 of the 196 countries in our world time zone table already have at least one region celebrating 2027.

  • Just before (UTC+02:00): Egypt, Greece, Russia (Kaliningrad), South Africa, Botswana, Bulgaria, Burundi, Cyprus and 21 more
  • Just after (UTC+00:00): Ireland, Portugal (Lisbon), United Kingdom, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Gambia, Ghana, Guinea and 9 more

Who celebrates at the same time as Spain?

These countries also reach midnight at UTC+01:00, so they welcome 2027 at exactly the same moment as Madrid: France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Nigeria, Poland, Sweden, Albania, Algeria, Andorra, Angola, Austria and 31 more.

New Year traditions in Spain

Spaniards eat twelve grapes in time with the twelve chimes of the Puerta del Sol clock in Madrid, which is broadcast live on television. In the Canary Islands many people celebrate twice: first with the mainland and an hour later at local midnight.

Frequently asked questions

What time is New Year 2027 in Spain in UTC?

Midnight in Madrid corresponds to 23:00 UTC on Thursday, December 31, 2026. Other regions of Spain follow, up to 1 hour apart.

How many time zones does Spain have on New Year's Eve?

Spain uses 2 different UTC offsets on December 31, from UTC+01:00 in Madrid to UTC+00:00 in Canary Islands.

Is daylight saving time in effect in Spain on New Year's Eve?

No. Madrid is on standard time (UTC+01:00) on December 31; daylight saving time is only used in summer.

Which countries celebrate New Year just before Spain?

The previous time zone to reach midnight is UTC+02:00, which includes Egypt, Greece, Russia (Kaliningrad), South Africa, Botswana, Bulgaria, Burundi, Cyprus and 21 more.
